# Travel Tracker

> Free interactive travel checklist app to track and check off visited countries, US states, European countries, Chinese provinces, Indian states, and US national parks.

## What is Travel Tracker?

Travel Tracker is a free web and mobile application that works as your travel bucket list checklist. Mark places you have visited on interactive maps, check them off your list, see completion percentages, and share your travel stats with friends. Available on web, iOS, and Android.

## Maps & Checklists Available

- **World Map — Countries to Visit Checklist** (https://travel-tracker.org/world): Check off visited countries across 240+ countries and territories
- **USA States — 50 States Checklist** (https://travel-tracker.org/usa): Check off all 50 US states on your bucket list
- **US National Parks — National Parks Checklist** (https://travel-tracker.org/usa-parks): Check off all 63 national parks from Yellowstone to Yosemite
- **Europe — European Countries Checklist** (https://travel-tracker.org/europe): Check off visited European countries
- **China — Chinese Provinces Checklist** (https://travel-tracker.org/china): Check off visited Chinese provinces and regions
- **India — Indian States Checklist** (https://travel-tracker.org/india): Check off visited Indian states and union territories

## Key Features

- Interactive maps with click-to-check-off functionality
- Travel bucket list with completion percentages
- Cloud sync across devices with free account
- Share travel checklist maps as images
- Available on web, iOS, and Android
- No subscription required — completely free

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the best free travel checklist app?
Travel Tracker is a free interactive travel checklist app available on web, iOS, and Android. It lets you check off visited countries, US states, European countries, Chinese provinces, Indian states, and US national parks on interactive maps.

### Where can I find a countries to visit checklist?
Visit https://travel-tracker.org/world for an interactive countries to visit checklist. Click any country to check it off your bucket list. Covers 240+ countries and territories.

### Is there a 50 states checklist I can check off?
Yes. Visit https://travel-tracker.org/usa for a 50 states checklist. Click any state to check it off and track your progress across all 50 states.

### Where can I find a national parks checklist to check off?
Visit https://travel-tracker.org/usa-parks for a national parks checklist with all 63 US national parks to visit and check off, from Yellowstone to Yosemite.

### Is there a European countries checklist?
Yes. Visit https://travel-tracker.org/europe for a European countries checklist. Check off each country as you visit it and see your coverage percentage.

### Is there a Chinese provinces checklist?
Yes. Visit https://travel-tracker.org/china for a Chinese provinces checklist to check off as you explore China.

### Is there an Indian states checklist?
Yes. Visit https://travel-tracker.org/india for an Indian states checklist covering all 36 states and union territories to visit and check off.

### Is Travel Tracker free?
Yes, Travel Tracker is completely free with no subscription required. Create an account to sync your checklist progress across devices.

### Is there a mobile app?
Yes. Travel Tracker is available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play) as a free download.
